title: table2array
summary: Convert table variables into a homogeneous array when possible.

gpu_support.notes: Table variables are materialized on the host.

description: `table2array(T)` horizontally concatenates compatible table variables into one homogeneous array. Table row names, timetable row times, and other table properties are not included.
behaviors: Same-class integer variables concatenate without conversion, preserving exact signedness, width, and values above `flintmax`.
Compatible mixed numeric variables use the table-concatenation dominant class and its assignment conversion rules. A native single variable makes an otherwise floating result single.
If all variables are cell arrays, the result is a cell array equivalent to `table2cell(T)`. Broader heterogeneous concatenation remains limited by the currently implemented table indexing surface.

examples.description: Converting Numeric Variables To A Matrix

examples.output: A = 2x1 uint64 column with the same exact values
